title: Jeyngol nder galle mawnikinaare
intro: Caggal mahe mawcfe galle laamorcfo 6urcfo doole e nder aduna 6ooycfo oo, ina wuuri 6ernde mum ina jogii sirlu mo hay yamiroore laamcfo waawaa suucfde. Nde taariindi fof ina sujjana laamɓe fenaande, ooɗoo ruuhu ina joginoo hoolaare deeƴnde ina huɓɓa e nder mum. Laamɗo leydi ndii ina goongɗini koye mum en diineeji, kono oo neɗɗo suɓii ko goonga e dow wellitaare, e dewal e dow kisal. Hannde, golle maa ko yiytude hol ko woni ooɗoo 6ernde cuusal, mo daartol mum heddii e yeruuji ɓurɗi doole e goonɗinal ngal ustataako.
clues: Miɗo hoɗi e nokku keewɗo ngalu e mawngu ngu alaa ɗo haaɗi, ɗo laamɗo leydi ndii joginoo doole timmuɗe e dow fof.
Nde wonɓe e sara am ɓee cujji laamɓe fenaande, miɗo joginoo fitirla goonɗinal deeƴka e nder ɓernde am.
Mi yi’i, mi ƴetti cukalel ngel ngaddaa e am e mbaadi ndi meeɗaa yiyeede - wonaa e jibinannde, kono ko e ndiyam maayo mawngo.
Miɗo ñaagii Joomiraawo am, miɗo ñaagii galle sara makko e nder Aljanna e kisndam e njurum taariindi am.
Cukalel ngel njibinaami ngel mawni ko e luulndaade laamɗo oo tigi rigi, miɗo darii e goonɗinal am hay so miɗo hulɓinii.
Ko miin woni mo innde mum teddiniraa e nder Qur’aana ko mi yeru iimanaagal, kadi miɗo hoɗi e galle laamorɗo Firawna e hoore mum.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
